photos.title: Hotels along the Grand Strand Beachfront 2
photos.what: Tall oceanfront towers along the beach in Myrtle Beach, seen from the sand, with a row of more towers into the distance. Beachgoers are small in the foreground; a shop building is at the left edge. Nothing in the picture shows whether a tower is a condo, a hotel or both.
photos.caption: Oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach.
photos.alt: Tall oceanfront towers along the beach in Myrtle Beach, with a row of more towers into the distance
photos.author: DiscoA340

photos.subject_check: Viewed full size 2026-11-01 by the writer, and again after the fix-round crop. The file's own title says hotels. The caption says only 'Oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach' (verifier's limit). The sentence after it is a rule from ledger row 6 (a building becomes a condo when its master deed is recorded) and makes no claim about these towers.
